title: Link with iQ — Updates
description: Blog posts, research notes, news, and changelog entries from Link with iQ.

items.title: linkwithiq.github.io launched
items.content_text: The Link with iQ site went live, bringing together our projects, resources, and writing in one place for the first time.

items.title: Why everything we build starts open
items.content_text: The case for publishing code from day one, even the embarrassing early commits — and what it costs us to do it that way.

items.title: How we scoped Community Toolkit down to something shippable
items.content_text: The feature list we cut, the one we kept, and why "smaller than feels responsible" was the right call.

items.title: What we found scoping civic issue-reporting tools
items.content_text: A survey of how residents currently report infrastructure problems, and where the gaps actually are before we write a line of Report It.

items.title: Shipped: site-wide Blog, Research, News, Policy, Community, and Terms pages
items.content_text: Expanded the site from a single homepage into a full set of pages, plus live GitHub-powered project stats, contributor avatars, and a good-first-issue feed.

items.title: Shipped: logo redrawn as vector, loading animation added
items.content_text: Replaced the raster logo with a hand-traced SVG version, and added a draw-in loading animation on first visit.
